description: This file contains Data Access Object (DAO) classes for managing annotations and annotation layers in the Superset project, including validation methods for uniqueness and existence checks.

classes.name: AnnotationDAO
classes.description: DAO class for Annotation model, providing validation for update uniqueness.

classes.name: AnnotationLayerDAO
classes.description: DAO class for AnnotationLayer model, providing methods to check for annotations and validate layer name uniqueness.

methods.name: validate_update_uniqueness
methods.description: Validates if an annotation's short description is unique within a layer, optionally excluding a specific annotation ID for updates.

methods.name: has_annotations
methods.description: Checks if given annotation layer IDs have associated annotations.

methods.name: validate_update_uniqueness
methods.description: Validates if an annotation layer name is unique, optionally excluding a specific layer ID for updates.
